#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

ll fastPow(ll a, ll b) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
        a = a * a % MOD;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fastPow(p, p - 1) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << fastPow(p, p) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    vector<char> visited((size_t)p, 0);
    ll cycles = 0;

    for (ll i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (visited[(size_t)i]) continue;
        ll cur = i;
        while (!visited[(size_t)cur]) {
            visited[(size_t)cur] = 1;
            cur = (cur * k) % p;
        }
        ++cycles;
    }

    cout << fastPow(p, cycles) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
